correctness.rationale: The projective friendship graph F_m has m triangles sharing a central vertex and dimension 2m; the fixed base-edge chart at W_i yields u_j v_j=xy w_j for the other k=m-1 triangles. The k leading monomials u_j v_j are pairwise coprime and form a regular sequence and Gröbner basis. Quotient has no xy torsion and becomes a Laurent-domain after xy inversion, proving primeness and exactness of the chart ideal. Serre S2 holds by complete intersection, while generic points of torus-invariant divisors are smooth (nonvanishing relevant Jacobian entries), giving R1 and normality; Gorenstein follows. The saturated chart cone has inequalities alpha,beta,gamma_j,delta_j>=0, gamma_j+delta_j>=alpha+beta. Its primitive extremal rays are exactly 2k coordinate rays and 2^(k+1) alpha/beta binary-choice rays; a slack-removal convex decomposition establishes completeness. The toric invariant-divisor exact sequence has cokernel torsionfree by explicit unit minor, giving local Cl rank 2^(k+1)-2=2^m-2. Initial ideal (u_jv_j) is squarefree, with 2^k coordinate components and Hilbert series (1+z)^k/(1-z)^(2m), multiplicity 2^k. Independently enumerated cone rays by hyperplane intersections for k=1,2,3, obtaining class ranks 2,6,14, in accord with general proof; finite enumerations are not used to infer exponential all-m formula.
